title: GrantThai Evidence record
description: Draft. One item under project.yaml `chain.Evidence`: a field record (spec/common/field_record.schema.json) in the CORE.EVIDENCE.* id space, plus the claim it supports and its strength cap. The statement is the record's `value`.

supports_claim_id.description: A causal reference Evidence -> Claim; must resolve to a record under chain.Claim (spec/common/links-and-sources.md, rule S006).

claim_strength_cap.description: Set to CONTRIBUTORY when the supporting mapping is ACCEPTED_BY_REQUESTER (rule CH003).
